name: io.github.pvliesdonk/kroki-mcp
title: Kroki MCP Server
description: MCP server wrapping a self-hosted Kroki instance for diagram rendering. Supports 29+ diagram types (PlantUML, Mermaid, GraphViz, D2, and more).

environmentVariables.name: KROKI_MCP_KROKI_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the self-hosted Kroki instance (e.g. http://localhost:8000)

environmentVariables.name: KROKI_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to enable write tools (default: true)
